**Changed**

Added ANN-local search instrumentation in [src/db.rs](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/src/db.rs:1) and exposed it through [measure_ann_search_only](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/measure_ann_search_only:1) as `--include-ann-stats`. I also kept a locality cleanup in the ANN fallback: non-pruned cluster scans now run in cluster-id order, and rerank candidates are sorted before the `f16` pass. The hybrid prune retry stays experimental behind `VDB_ENABLE_CLUSTER_PRUNE`. I updated [strategy.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/strategy.md:1), [research_notes.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/research_notes.md:1), [campaign_journal.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/campaign_journal.md:1), and [tools/README.md](/__modal/volumes/vo-WauxZXgTehLrBgTwgcOh2J/campaign/workspace/.meta_codex/tools/README.md:1).

**Current expectation**

Clean serial default-path validation is still official and valid: correctness passed at `1.0000` recall, and the quick benchmark reached `11500.94 QPS`. On the ANN side, the best local search-only point this cycle was `14 / 136 / 576` at `6243.95 QPS`, `0.9505` recall. The new ANN stats show the real steady-state issue: this path still scans about `12.2k` vectors/query, with roughly `153 us` in routing, `277 us` in scan, and only `49 us` in rerank. Clean exact ANN quick runs with cache disabled stayed only around `4275-4282 QPS` at roughly `0.953` recall, so this cycle does not improve the validated ANN frontier.

**Next best move**

Attack scanned-vector count directly. The current centroid-radius prune signal is too weak, and the hybrid retry barely pruned anything. The next credible branch is a stronger shortlist stage or per-cluster substructure that materially cuts the `~12k` scanned-vector budget before exact validation. Use `measure_ann_search_only --include-ann-stats` to cull ideas quickly, but keep the exact official wrapper as the decision gate.

Public-target context is unchanged as of April 22, 2026: [Lushbinary’s April 8, 2026 writeup](https://lushbinary.com/blog/glm-5-1-vectordbbench-6000-tool-calls-21k-qps/) still describes the `21.5k` ANN class, and the official benchmark site is [Vector DB Bench](https://vector-db-bench.kcores.com/).
